text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, Doto, Ayabe, and Top Road
have teamed up, huh. Sounds
like a strong
team.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Ryan and Bright. They look like
they're up to no good... Time
to go into
ninja mode. Nin nin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a triathlon,
we'll probably need
someone with good
endurance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about Spe? She's a great eater, so
she knows how to fuel up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, my. Her plate is overflowing as usual.
Hehe, going for seconds,
are we? She's
still got more room to fill up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I think you're right. She seems like she'd
have good endurance. I'm
sure she would
be an invaluable addition to our team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right,
let's wait till she's finished eating
and ask her! Uh, Bright?
What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We'll need brains too, since we're
new to this kind of
competition. I have
someone in mind for the last spot.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Triathlon, triathlon... There it is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Oh, Ryan! And you're with Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you were looking for books about the
triathlon. Well that makes
this easy. Spe,
would you like to join our team?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you... scouting me?! Why me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Cause you can eat a ton, so you'll have
plenty of energy to complete a triathlon.
Not to mention, you've got some nice,
supple muscles on
you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I do? How can you tell just by looking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan knows muscles so well, she can hear
their little voices!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hah, well believe me when I say I came to
you 'cause you have talent.
So, what do
you say? Wanna team up with us?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, to tell you the truth, I'm more
interested in the prize buffet than
the
triathlon itself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you've got your eye on the prize!
That's
perfect, 'cause we're in it
to win it too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really? Sounds great!
I'd love to join you!
Let's win this buffet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Spe's joining Ryan! Gee, this team looks
strong too! Let's put a star by
this one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, getting some good intel there,
Detective Matikanetannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
WHA! B-B-Bright?! I'm not spying or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you're still looking for a team,
would you
consider joining ours?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um, I think you've got the wrong
person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so. I'm inviting you because
I've seen how good you are
at gathering
information and applying your research to
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A win would mean so much to me. I want
to uphold the Mejiro name. And I also
want to win for my big sister Ryan, who's
watched over me
since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So please lend me your skills. To have a
chance at victory, we need
you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You need... me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-i-it would be an honor!
If you don't mind
having me! I'm pretty
average, but I'll do
my best for the team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's an honor to have you.
With this lineup,
I feel confident we can win
it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hey Kita,
today's the deadline for entering
the triathlon, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I know...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think we can find two team
members?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...What do you th—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Ack!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry!
I wasn't looking where I was going.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all, don't you fret. Oh? Are
you two entering the
triathlon?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...No, well... we're, um...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I saw your name on the list, Bakushin O.
Have you decided on your
teammates?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the first leg,
Sakura Bakushin O. In
the second leg, Sakura Bakushin O. Third
leg, Sakura Bakushin O. And the anchor,
Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you seriously doing the whole
event by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am indeed!
At first I asked my classmates
to join me, but everyone
declined.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They seemed worried about me, saying it
would require too much
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But perhaps I made them too nervous to
team up with me, being the
class
representative and all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that's why, as class rep, I have
decided to face the challenge
head-on
and enter as a one-person team! Ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: W-wow... You've got a will of steel!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You must have overcome a lot of trials
here to have that kind of
determination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Reckless as it may be, I welcome the
challenge! The tougher the
better! I'll
enter even if I'm by myself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Reckless as it may be... The tougher the
better...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia, let's enter! I actually do want to
compete!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We've finally got a chance to do an event
together. Even if we're no match for the
others, even if they laugh at us,
I want to team up with
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O, would you do us the honor of
joining our team? Please
let us learn from
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We still don't have enough teammates!
You'd be doing us a big favor!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see,
you are in a predicament! Very well!
If that's the case, then I will
lend you a
hand. Why? Because I'm the class rep!
Hey, hey, hey! My search is over! This is perfect! This is the team I've been looking for!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, it was worth waiting till the last
minute. Who knew such an
interesting
team would form!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's like a collision of personalities—
no, a
collision of variables! This
can only result
in a big BANG!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So anyways, I'll be joining your team!
You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Okay! Pleased to have you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. With these three teams, we complete
the roster.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
On team "Centurial"—T.M. Opera O,
Meisho Doto, Admire Vega, and
Narita
Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
On team "Muscle"—Mejiro Ryan, Mejiro
Bright, Special Week, and

Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And team "Bakushin"—Sakura Bakushin O,
Gold Ship, Kitasan Black,
and Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There are eight teams in total. This is
shaping up to be an exciting
anniversary
event! What good fortune!
